verdict.rationale: Poke's API (per docs) only supports sending messages programmatically and triggering Poke from external services, not the broader UI capabilities like managing integrations, creating MCP recipes, deploying websites, or human-task requests, which appear to require chat/UI interaction. missing for 10: API parity for integrations management, MCP recipe creation/deployment, website/email/human-task features, independent confirmation of API completeness.
